data.name: California Underground
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to California Underground — a sun-soaked sandbox set in a quirky coastal California town pulsing with mid‑to‑late ’90s indie energy. You arrive ready to make a life: grab a job, save up cash, and dive headfirst into the local DIY music scene. Promote shows, host epic parties, and level up your gear to build events that become the talk of the town.

Everything here is hands‑on. Physics‑based gameplay turns everyday tasks into satisfying challenges — from carefully assembling the perfect burger to hauling and wiring massive sound rigs under pressure. Plan your shows, promote,  rig the PA, decorate, and improvise when things inevitably go sideways. Creativity and experimentation are rewarded; no two nights are the same.

The town feels alive thanks to advanced NPCs with schedules, goals, and distinct personalities. Befriend local eccentrics, and win over the crowd — your choices shape relationships, unlock new story paths, and even alter the environment. Host a backyard set that sparks a scene, or throw a chaotic beach party that changes the town forever.

California Underground is equal parts cozy life sim and chaotic event-builder, packed with humor, heart, and replayability. Whether you’re a careful planner or a last‑minute legend, carve out your place in a vibrant community where music, mischief, and memories collide. Welcome to the scene — make it yours.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD required. Minimum specs allow for 1080p 30FPS low settings gameplay.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD required. Minimum specs allow for 1080p 30FPS low settings gameplay.
